item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and a few squally thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Showers will be heavier at times. The trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the coast of southern China in the following couple of days. The weather will remain unsettled. There will be occasional showers with squally thunderstorms. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, there will be one or two rain patches over the coast of southern China midweek next week. With the strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve and it will be hot during the day over Guangdong in the latter part of next week.
